technical.summary: Strong uptrend structure with golden cross and new highs, but extreme overbought conditions on short-term oscillators create elevated pullback risk; better suited for continuation on dips than immediate entry.

fundamental.summary: FTNT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 84 days—insufficient smart money alignment for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Senior Republican congressman McCaul liquidated ~$200-350K in FTNT (Oct 2021), market is in fear mode (32/100) with bearish sentiment (43.7%), creating potential contrarian buy opportunity despite insider selling pressure.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (299.36) with imminent CPI event (1 day) creates acute macro stress; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 84 days adds secondary risk layer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross with new 20-day highs and contrarian buy signal in fear-zone market create technical setup for continuation, especially if VIX volatility stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme RSI overbought (80.03), VIX crisis regime (299.36), imminent CPI event, price below 200-EMA/50-SMA, insider selling, and zero fundamental conviction create compounding risk that outweighs technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Already holding FTNT with existing position; technical golden cross and contrarian fear-zone setup offer marginal appeal, but compounding macro/fundamental risks and sector concentration make new entry unjustified.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (299.36) with imminent CPI event (1 day) creates acute drawdown risk; RSI extreme overbought (80.03) signals exhaustion into resistance; insider selling and zero smart-money conviction provide no fundamental support.
decision.recommended_exit: For existing position: atr_trail_1x to protect against VIX-driven reversal; do not add.
